sv.title: Källor om mystiska larm: Kan ha varit Irans drönare
sv.summary: Mer uppgifter framkommer nu efter mystiska säkerhetsincidenter runt USA:s flygbaser i Storbritannien tidigare i höst. Drönare som troligtvis skickats av Iran uppges ha varit inblandade.

en.title: Sources on mysterious alarms: May have been Iran's drones
en.summary: More information is emerging after mysterious security incidents around US air bases in the United Kingdom earlier this autumn. Drones believed to have been sent by Iran are reported to have been involved.
